rules: net: the flat net (bundle_net); C[p][t] = (weight of t->p) - (weight of p->t) over normal arcs; read and inhibitor arcs move nothing
law: a vector y over places with y.C = 0 is conserved; its value is y.M0
preserved: the part's law lifted onto the composite's places has y.C = 0 and residual = {}
extended: z.C = 0, z >= 0, and z equals the lifted law (up to the ratio given) on every composite place that holds a member of the part
changed: residual[t] = y.C[t] != 0 exactly for the transitions listed
bounded by invariant: z.C = 0, z >= 0, z[p] > 0, bound(p) = floor(z.M0 / z[p])
bounded by capacity: the place's capacity is positive (a transition that would pass it is not enabled)
witness: fire the trace from the initial marking; every step must be enabled; the end marking must equal the one given, and for a deadlock nothing may be enabled there
complete search: no certificate beyond the engine's count; re-running the search with the same bounds must give the same verdict

catalog.note: The catalog's sizes and ports are this port's judgment; `why` says what each part is for. Build a composition with `instances`.

parts.title: Bounded queue
parts.why: Work waiting to be taken; capacity makes the slots a conserved resource.

parts.title: Resource pool
parts.why: A fixed number of interchangeable workers, machines or seats.

laws: tokens("next_reserve") + tokens("next_charge") + tokens("committing") + tokens("unwind_charge") + tokens("unwind_reserve") + tokens("completed") + tokens("rolled_back") == 1
parts.title: Two-step saga
Lock
parts.why: One holder at a time. The `held` port is what a guard link reads to keep another part out.

parts.title: Token bucket
parts.why: At most `capacity` calls in a burst, refilled one at a time. Bounded by its capacity, not by a conservation law: a source and a sink.

parts.title: Circuit breaker
parts.why: Calls pass only while closed; trips on failure, probes, then recovers or reopens. Exactly one of the three states is marked.

parts.title: Batcher
parts.why: Collects `size` items and emits one batch. Joined to a queue it consumes the queue's items, which changes the queue's own law (a worked 'explained' case).

parts.title: Approval desk
parts.why: Each request is approved or rejected, never both: requests + approved + rejected is conserved.

stock.about: stock level (the cap on hand and on order)

parts.title: Stock with reordering
parts.why: On hand and on order are both capped by the stock level; consumption is a sink, ordering a source. Bounded by capacity alone.

machines.about: machines in service or in repair

parts.title: Machines that fail
parts.why: Of `machines`, some are up and some down: up + down is conserved. Joined to a pool's `available` it makes the pool's size a moving target, which breaks the pool's own law.

parts.title: SIR epidemic
parts.why: Susceptible, infected, recovered: S + I + R = N. Infection needs one of each of S and I.

parts.title: WIP-limited stage
parts.why: Work moves ready, doing, done; `doing` is capped so the stage never holds more than `wip`.

parts.title: Traffic light
parts.why: Red, green, yellow in a ring; one is marked. A guard link from `green` lets a queue's dequeue through only on green.
